Review of [Lulu and Georgia](https://www.trustpilot.com/review/www.luluandgeorgia.com)

* * *

## [ZERO customer service, don't buy it you may need any customer service](https://www.trustpilot.com/reviews/6a234d24c34bd1121cc828b4)
I purchased some expensive throw pillows (4). After being at a distribution center 30 miles from my house one set was sent over 300 miles away and then further away before getting to me. The other set came but it was just the filler and not the covering. The company has NO phone to call. They have an email, that was never ever answered. If you go on line during an 8 hr period West Coast timezone, you can chat with a bot for a bit about your concerns and after a few lobs, a customer service person will come on chat. Once I got them, they were helpful . But at over $100 per pillow, I want someone to answer. Find the item you want (they have good selection) and then find another company that carries it.

May 30, 2026

* * *

Reply from Lulu and Georgia

Jun 8, 2026

Hi Rob,

We sincerely apologize for the delay with both your order and our response. We are experiencing a high volume of inquiries right now and are working hard to respond to everyone as quickly as possible. Thank you for your patience.
